get.description:
Get Fear & Greed Index data from the ClickHouse database.

Returns data from the serving.fear_greed_index table for the requested date range.
If no date range is specified, returns the last 30 days of data.

Get historical TAO/USD price data with specified time bucket frequency.

get.description:
Get subnet identity changes for a specific netuid.

Returns the historical identity changes (name and info) for a subnet,
ordered by block number in descending order.

Args:

schema.title: Response Get Subnet Identity Changes Api Beta Subnets Identity Changes Get

get.description:

Useful for tooltips and previews where full content isn't needed.

get.description:
Learn what's this subnet about.

Returns the about page content including problem, solution, validators,
miners, future plans, benchmark info, team members, and read more links.

Args:
    netuid: The subnet ID to fetch about content for

get.summary: (Free) Get 24h price sparklines for all subnets
get.description:
Fetches price sparkline data for all subnets over the specified time period.
Returns downsampled price data suitable for small sparkline charts.

Args:
    hours: Number of hours of historical data (default: 24, max: 168/7 days)
    points: Target number of data points to return per subnet (default: 24, max: 48)

Returns:
    Dictionary containing sparkline data for each subnet
